text: A Psalm of David (beloved). 1 Ascribe to the LORD {YHWH}, O heavenly beings (sons of God), ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
Ascribe to the LORD {YHWH} the glory due His name; worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness (in holy attire).
The voice of the LORD {YHWH} is over the waters; the God of glory thunders; the LORD is heard over many waters.
The voice of the LORD {YHWH} is powerful; the voice of the LORD is majestic.
The voice of the LORD {YHWH} breaks the cedars; the LORD shatters the cedars of Lebanon (whiteness).
He makes Lebanon (whiteness) skip like a calf, and Sirion (Mount Hermon) like a young wild ox.
The voice of the LORD {YHWH} strikes with flames of fire.
The voice of the LORD {YHWH} shakes the wilderness; the LORD shakes the Wilderness of Kadesh (holy).
The voice of the LORD {YHWH} twists the oaks (LORD makes the deer to calve) and strips the forests bare. And in His temple all cry, “Glory!”
The LORD {YHWH} sits enthroned over the flood; the LORD is enthroned as King forever.
The LORD {YHWH} gives His people strength; the LORD blesses His people with peace.
